exclusions: No decision items,choice labels,target-bundle contents,heldout/final/confirmation sources or evaluator source-group fields are projected.
No peer-synthetic profile text,inferred preference labels,private archive contents,rejected metadata transfers or newly crawled sources.

checks: exact preapproved release file SHA256 matches
all source dispositions approved_atemporal and split_eligibility atemporal_only
every permitted span matches its attributed text; all uncovered characters are whitespace
entire released content hashes preserved without truncation
exact preapproved release file SHA256 matches
all source dispositions approved_atemporal and split_eligibility atemporal_only
every permitted span matches its attributed text; all uncovered characters are whitespace
entire released content hashes preserved without truncation

known_limits: Only three already-released fit source records are available in this initial bundle; not a broad researcher corpus.
Records are upstream curated attributable excerpts,not complete original web articles. Each released record is copied in full with no truncation or extra normalization.
Original released schema has no title field; title is null rather than invented. Real canonical URLs and original author attribution are retained.
atemporal_only provenance does not establish historical availability before any evaluation date.
No profile extraction,model/network calls,scoring or evaluator-target access was performed.

schema.digest_rule: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON of the top-level payload excluding digest_sha256; sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False; no trailing newline in digest input

source_fields.author: original attribution string
source_fields.provenance: fit release/content hashes,original source identity,attribution and exact permitted-span character offsets
source_fields.title: original title string or null if unavailable
